enunciado: Use DFS with three colors (WHITE unvisited, GRAY on the recursion stack, BLACK finished) to decide whether a directed graph has cycles. Test with 0->1, 1->2, 2->3 (no cycle) and then add 3->1.
objetivos: Use richer visit states than a bool
pistas: An edge to a GRAY vertex closes a cycle.
When you finish exploring a vertex, paint it BLACK.
An edge to a BLACK vertex does not indicate a cycle.
